source: FusionHub 'External Output' MCAP recording of an LPMS-B2 over Bluetooth, 2026-09-28, taken on the real cell while the UR5e elbow swept 25 deg at 0.4 rad/s
schema: Fusion.proto.ImuData (stream_data.proto), read from the FileDescriptorSet embedded in the .mcap
note: Recorded to pin down a data disagreement between FusionHub's own display and this console. Every value below is EXACTLY what FusionHub published: accelerometer in g, gyroscope in DEGREES per second, quaternion in the WORLD-TO-SENSOR sense, magnetometer in microtesla, and a timecode field that is bit-identical on all 4280 messages. `euler_deg` is FusionHub's own roll/pitch/yaw for the same sample and is the reference this console's orientation is checked against.
